name: Bee
description: Embodies swarm coordination, hexagonal optimization, and distributed thermoregulation. Serves as a geometric intelligence archetype for collective computation.

scope.definition: Ratio of honey volume stored per unit wax mass in hexagonal cells compared to the next-best regular tessellation. Derives from the honeycomb conjecture: hexagons minimize total perimeter for equal-area tiling of a plane.

evidence.source: Hales (1999) 'Proof of the Honeycomb Conjecture', Discrete & Computational Geometry 36:5-69; engineering measurements confirm wax economy vs. circular and square cells.
cross_domain_examples: basalt columnar jointing (Devils Postpile, Giants Causeway)
soap bubble foam geometry (Plateau's laws)
graphene lattice structure
insect compound eye facet arrangement
aerospace engineering honeycomb panels

scope.falsifiability: No non-hexagonal regular tessellation has been shown to match hexagonal cells' wax-to-storage ratio. If such a geometry is found, the model requires revision.
scope.measurement_limits: Value assumes uniform cell depth. Varies ±0.01 with cell aspect ratio and wax thickness. Theoretical maximum; real colonies deviate slightly from perfect hexagons.

scope.definition: Fraction of colony foragers recruited by waggle dance that arrive within 50m of the indicated food source, averaged across multiple trials and distances 200m–5km.

evidence.source: von Frisch (1967) 'The Dance Language and Orientation of Bees' (Nobel Prize, 1973); replicated by Seeley (1995) 'The Wisdom of the Hive' and Seeley (2010) 'Honeybee Democracy'; 50+ independent replications.
cross_domain_examples: polar coordinate radar navigation systems
GPS satellite signal: bearing + duration encoding spatial position
bat echolocation: temporal pattern encodes vector to target

scope.falsifiability: If bees recruited by waggle dance perform no better than naive scouts at finding the indicated source, the dance fails as a spatial information channel.
scope.measurement_limits: Precision degrades at distances >5km and under crosswind. Recruits interpret dance probabilistically — precision is population-level, not per-individual.

scope.definition: Material efficiency of honeycomb hexagonal geometry — ratio of usable wax cell wall area to total wax consumed per unit enclosed volume, compared to alternative geometries (square, triangular, circular).

evidence.source: Hales (1999) 'The honeycomb conjecture', Discrete and Computational Geometry 25:1-22 (mathematical proof); Thompson (1917) 'On Growth and Form', Cambridge UP.
cross_domain_examples: hexagonal tiling minimizes perimeter per unit area — Hales (1999) formal mathematical proof
dragonfly wing venation: hexagonal cell distribution for strength/weight optimization
graphene hexagonal lattice: maximum bond strength per atom using 6-fold geometry
soap bubble foam: hexagonal cells emerge spontaneously at minimum surface energy
columnar basalt (Giant's Causeway): hexagonal fracture pattern minimizes energy of thermal contraction

scope.falsifiability: If a regular polygonal tiling is found that achieves greater area per unit perimeter than hexagons, the Hales proof has an error.
scope.measurement_limits: Mathematical optimality is proven for regular geometries. Real honeycomb deviates <1% from ideal hexagon due to construction tolerances and cell-size variation for worker vs drone brood.

scope.definition: Information transfer accuracy of honeybee waggle dance — fraction of recruited foragers that arrive within 200 m of the communicated food source after following dance instructions.

evidence.source: von Frisch (1967) 'The Dance Language and Orientation of Bees', Harvard UP (Nobel Prize 1973); Dyer (2002) 'The biology of the dance language', Annual Review of Entomology 47:917-949.
cross_domain_examples: waggle dance angle encodes sun-compass bearing to within ±15°; duration encodes distance within ±10%
foragers recruited by dance arrive at target location with 0.82-0.94 frequency depending on source distance
meerkat alarm calls encode predator type and urgency — convergent symbolic communication in social species

scope.falsifiability: If foragers following waggle dance cues arrive at random locations with no directional bias toward the communicated source, the dance does not transmit directional information.
scope.measurement_limits: Accuracy decreases with distance (>2 km) and in topographically complex terrain where sun-compass cues are ambiguous. Dance-follower sampling within the hive introduces additional noise.

scope.definition: Fraction of scout bee votes (waggle dances for a nest site) cast for the eventual swarm destination — quorum threshold achieved before swarm departure.

evidence.source: Seeley & Visscher (2004) 'Group decision making in nest-site selection by honey bees', Apidologie 35:101-116; Seeley (2010) 'Honeybee Democracy', Princeton UP.
cross_domain_examples: swarm departs only after >80% of active scouts supporting single site — democratic quorum threshold
piping signal suppresses rival sites — active error-correction in consensus building
fish school split decisions: parallel collective decision by democratic majority — convergent quorum sensing

scope.falsifiability: If swarms depart before reaching >60% scout consensus, or if piping signals are found to not suppress rival dancers, the democratic quorum model is incorrect.
scope.measurement_limits: Quorum threshold varies with urgency — starving swarms accept lower consensus. Weather constraints can force premature departure at 65-70% consensus.

scope.definition: Precision of honeybee cluster temperature maintenance — standard deviation of brood nest temperature from 35°C target across ambient temperatures ranging from -30°C to +45°C.

evidence.source: Fahrenholz et al. (1989) 'Thermal analysis of a honey bee colony', Journal of Comparative Physiology B 159:551-560; Stabentheiner et al. (2010) metabolic rate in thermoregulating clusters.
cross_domain_examples: honeybee cluster maintains 35±1°C brood nest across external temperatures -30°C to +45°C
bee metabolism scales with cluster size — larger clusters achieve better thermal regulation
emperor penguin huddle: analogous collective thermoregulation by rotational heat distribution
naked mole rat burrow thermoregulation: colonial body-heat pooling for consistent tunnel temperature

scope.falsifiability: If brood nest temperature measured by inserted thermocouples deviates >3°C from 35°C during normal colony conditions, the tight regulation model is overstated.
scope.measurement_limits: Thermoregulation precision requires minimum colony size of ~5000 bees. Small swarms (< 2000) show ±4°C variance. Regulation fails during severe winter starvation or disease-induced population collapse.
